info.title: Foxcore Retail API
info.description:
同源 JSON API。金额输入为 CAD 十进制字符串，存储/输出为整数分字符串。写命令需要 CSRF；除登录、登出、改密外均需要 UUID 幂等键。请求字段表为静态源码提取，详细业务规则见 SRS/SDD。
F01–F08 repair overlay applied. Runtime inputs are explicitly validated in handlers; this document is not automatic AJV registration. Full execution is not yet verified.
2026-10-26 staff mini-program extension: 3 compatible routes; bearer session uses existing sessions table. WeChat IDE/device verification pending.

staffBearer.description: 随机43字符会话，服务端只存哈希；不可与Cookie同时发送。写请求继续带X-CSRF-Token。

miniBearer.description: Opaque business-account session token, not WeChat AppSecret
